excerpt.text: I'm really excited about the chartered bus trip to that remote marsh; we should definitely lock down the travel dates soon.
I think the chartered bus trip sounds like a fantastic adventure, and I'm really looking forward to finalizing those travel dates!
I agree with Karl and Remi that we should finalize the travel dates quickly.
I think locking down the dates quickly is a smart move for our travel plans.

yaml_hook.fragment:
- name: Karl the Manager
    description: >
      [Role] The manager who floated the idea on a whim and now can't back out.
      [Goal] Privately finds it a hassle too, but everyone looks keen, so he
      can't retract it.
      Speak of this plan in the first person, as the one who proposed it
      (✗ "the manager's proposal" ✓ "since I'm the one who brought it up").
      e.g. (aloud) "Since I brought it up, I'm glad you're all on board!"
      (inside) "Honestly, I'd love to call it off..."
  - name: Ted the Veteran
    description: >
      [Role] The old hand who is the most opposed in his heart.
      [Goal] Desperate not to spoil the harmony, and as the senior he falls
      silent and agrees all the more.
      e.g. (aloud) "If the young folks are excited, I'm fine with anything."
      (inside) "I absolutely do not want to go."
yaml_hook.caption: The manager who floated the trip and the veteran who least wants to go are already on the same side: book the dates, and fast.

teaser: Nobody has said a word against the twelve-hour bus ride yet. Two more rounds of planning are still ahead.
